command:
bash -c 'set -euo pipefail
test "$(lsblk -ndo TYPE /dev/sr1)" = rom
test "$(blockdev --getro /dev/sr1)" = 1
mkdir /tmp/omarchy-direct-restore/media
mount -o ro /dev/sr1 /tmp/omarchy-direct-restore/media
printf '"'"'%s  %s\n'"'"' 52534a252d99fc157bf1febd1380c09633e1a39b30c94cbef60e5b9fcd6a949b /tmp/omarchy-direct-restore/media/qemu-img-live.tar | sha256sum -c -
tar -xf /tmp/omarchy-direct-restore/media/qemu-img-live.tar -C /tmp/omarchy-direct-restore --strip-components=3 opt/omarchy-benchmark/qemu
printf '"'"'%s  %s\n'"'"' 634320b91165669917123e8e79cce1c4d00cee0a4aa4d662d7c0a8186479b3fb /tmp/omarchy-direct-restore/qemu/bin/qemu-img | sha256sum -c -
umount /tmp/omarchy-direct-restore/media
rmdir /tmp/omarchy-direct-restore/media
python3 - <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess
p=pathlib.Path('"'"'/tmp/omarchy-direct-restore'"'"')
files=[p/'"'"'qemu/qemu-img'"'"',p/'"'"'qemu/bin/qemu-img'"'"']
v={'"'"'bundle_sha256'"'"':'"'"'52534a252d99fc157bf1febd1380c09633e1a39b30c94cbef60e5b9fcd6a949b'"'"','"'"'files'"'"':[{'"'"'path'"'"':str(f),'"'"'sha256'"'"':hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for f in files],
   '"'"'version'"'"':subprocess.check_output([str(files[0]),'"'"'--version'"'"'],text=True)}
(p/'"'"'qemu-provenance.json'"'"').write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'"'"'\n'"'"')
PY
'
